author: rorupuntou
content:
Hey everyone! Just rebased and cleaned up my Cohort 7 PR (#453) onto the latest `main` so it's conflict-free and ready to merge whenever Mario or Josh have a moment:
<https://github.com/eth-protocol-fellows/cohort-seven/pull/453>

It wraps up our **EIP-2537 (BLS12-381) Precompile Hardening & Conformance** project along with our final report and presentation slides:
- **Core EEST / EELS & Fuzzing:** Merged PR `execution-specs#3641` (MSM & Pairing hardening verified via EELS mutation testing across 6 L1 clients), `protocol-mesh#2` (100% 8-client `xref` mapping of 37 EIP-2537 functions + differential/invariant fuzzer), `execution-specs#3945` (`MAP_FP_TO_G1` & `MAP_FP2_TO_G2` negative vectors), and `execution-specs#3935` (EIP-155 >64-bit legacy Chain ID multi-client fix for #3930).
- **Ecosystem Security & Privacy:** `Ethereum-dAI/rl-evals#4` (Harbor EIP-7702 sweeper benchmark) and `kohaku-py v0.3.1` (`ethereum/kohaku#335` & `#356`).
- **Final Report (HackMD):** <https://hackmd.io/npFjnHStSaWsJhWNJnyk9A>
